rows.en: All right, understood!

Nngh… Doctor Death ordered me to keep an eye on DARK's movements, but…

I see, Dr. Komyoji… The secret of a special circuit, how interesting. We'll wait for an opening and take it for ourselves.

Heh heh heh…

A special circuit, how interesting. This will make a fine gift for Lord Don Horror! Shako Monster! Snatch that special circuit!

Whenever I come near someone, something terrible always happens. I'm a man who brings misfortune…

That's right… I mustn't stay here! I'll cause her trouble too. I have to go, as far away as I can…

But why is it? I feel as if I have a daughter about her age too… I just have that feeling.
Where? Where? Where is he?
Nngh… Search, search!
There he is! Over there!
DARK Destruction Squad! I won't let you do as you please!!
Ah, so you're… the android they say Dr. Komyoji built?
How do you know that…?
From TDF intelligence… Anyway, I've taken that Dr. Komyoji into protection.
What!? Dr. Komyoji? Where? Where is the doctor?
Save the joyful reunion for later… First, cover the Pointer with the doctor in it!
Ah, Doctor!!
Ah, you!!
Anne!!
Anne!!
Ah, Jiro!!
Waaaaagh…

Hee hee hee…

Professor Gill has raised the ultrasonic flute's cycle to ten times what it was! This is finally the end of Komyoji's android!
Traitor… Destruction is your fate!
Jiro!? What's wrong? Are you all right?
Waaaaagh… Don't come near me… ugh… waagh!

…!? It's the sound of this flute that's doing it!

There must be something, some way to block out the sound of this flute…

That's it! If I get in the Pointer…
Now!
The car horn drowned out the flute… Thank you, Anne.
Kikaider!! Fall at the hands of Kaimen Green of the DARK Destruction Squad!

As long as DARK carries out destruction and torments innocent people, I will fight!

That is… the mission entrusted to me by Dr. Komyoji!

Kaimen Green…

Other organizations are after the special circuit… Capture Komyoji quickly. No matter what, it must not be stolen by another organization! Hurry, hurry!!

Kaimen Green… We've recovered the clown-type robot Komyoji built from the scrapyard!

It must be a robot holding Komyoji's secret! Hurry to the DARK torture chamber and make it spill the secret of the special circuit!
Hee hee hee… Can't move, can you? I've pulled the fuse from the behavior circuit in your electronic brain…
WHAT… ARE YOU GOING TO DO?
You know Dr. Komyoji's secret! I want to know it!
I HAVE BEEN TELLING YOU… I DO NOT REMEMBER…
You're still saying that? If you won't talk, I'll make you talk! I'll show you how terrifying DARK can be!
OOH, OOH… WHAT I DO NOT KNOW, I DO NOT KNOW…
Stubborn thing!
We've brought the detonator!
Good! Set the detonator!
Kaimen Green, are the preparations done?
The preparations are done…

Good…

If you can't get the secret of the special circuit out of that piece of junk, blow it up and destroy the evidence!

Yes, sir…

Did you hear that, junk heap! If you don't spill the secret, I'll blow you up!

Now, talk! This current is extremely painful! Do it too many times, and before long you'll come apart into pieces.
COWARD…
You piece of junk!
OOOH…

A signal tone!?

I see… It only gets through between androids? And only ones from the same maker…

This is… from the clown robot Dr. Komyoji built! It's a signal from Jinbe!

"Captured by DARK. Help me."

…!?

Where? Where are you, Jinbe!? I'll rescue you, I promise! Hang on until then! Jinbe!!

A signal tone!?

I see… It only gets through between androids? And only ones from the same maker…

This is a signal from the clown robot Dr. Komyoji built, Jinbe!

"Captured by DARK. Help me."

…!?

Where? Where are you, Jinbe!? I'll rescue you, I promise! Hang on until then! Jinbe!!
We came after getting word from the TDF! I hear Dr. Komyoji's been found? [HERO4], we're covering the Pointer!
We came after getting word from the TDF! I hear Dr. Komyoji's been found? [HERO4], we're covering the Pointer!
Okay…
I CANNOT… TAKE ANY MORE… AAAH!!
Hee hee hee… Your body has started to come apart!
Make it talk, quickly! Komyoji's secret… make it talk, quickly!!
HANG IN THERE, JINBE…
HANG IN THERE, JINBE…
KIKAIDER… THE SECRET OF THE SPECIAL CIRCUIT IS IN YOUR MEMORY UNIT…
In my memory unit?
In my memory unit?
YES… THE DOCTOR HAD YOUR BODY MEMORIZE IT, IN CASE OF EMERGENCY.
Then the formula for the special circuit is stored in my memory unit?
Then the formula for the special circuit is stored in my memory unit?

KIKAIDER… PROTECT THE SECRET… FROM THE HANDS OF EVIL.

GOOD… BYE…
Jinbe! Jinbe!!
Jinbe! Jinbe!!

Hm!? It's stopped responding? It was only a piece of scrapyard junk anyway…

All right, blow it up!!
Jinbe! Jinbe!! DARK, I won't forgive you!!
Hee hee hee, Kikaider. Traitors are destined to perish!

Nngh… Curse you, Kikaider, you'll pay for this!

Even if we can't unlock the secret of the special circuit, once the Devil Circuit is complete… you'll be finished in one blow!
Doctor! Dr. Komyoji!
Ah!?
No… Dr. Komyoji is gone!?
What's going on!?

…………

He must have run away while we were fighting. But why?
"Dr. Komyoji… Where on earth have you gone? With your memory lost like that…"

Nngh, that Komyoji… It seems he's made a clean getaway.

Still, DARK is in the same boat, in that they failed to decipher the secret of the special circuit…

Makuu and DARK… What a vexing bunch they are.
Exactly so, Doctor Death.
Leader…

uncertain: U01639-U01670: Jinbe's katakana robot speech (and Jiro's katakana signal reply U01662/U01663) rendered in capitals to keep the mechanical voice
U01654/U01655: 『』 signal message kept as double-quoted text
U01674-U01676: one Jiro/Kikaider line split across two speaker variants and a narration-kind row
U01684: 『』 thought kept as double-quoted text
U01610: Hunter Killer (Makuu) also eyeing the circuit, as Doctor Death notes in U01685
